role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 一旦卓尔游侠箭所能及，再想逃脱绝非易事。一阵寒风吹过，敌人全部噤声，一阵冰箭射过，敌人无一幸免。
hero_summary_en: Not many can escape Drow Ranger once she's within range. After her foes have been silenced with a chilling blast, she finishes them off with a barrage of slowing, ice-tipped arrows that few can survive.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。
notes_en: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

scepter_loc.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter_loc.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

abilities.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
abilities.description_zh: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。
abilities.description_en: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_multishot
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。
notes_en: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_glacier
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
abilities.description_en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得%trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%%敏捷加成。
abilities.description_en: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
abilities.description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。
